title: Structure Pack Trio #23 (맥시 비대칭 몬드리안·물결 / 일반 폴카도트·매끈 / 일반 굵은 스트라이프·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, curtain bangs long straight hair sweeping past the shoulders — her body carries 4 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 irregular rectangular areas by hazy transition zones running both vertically and horizontally. One vertical transition zone runs the full height of her figure about 41% of the way across her figure from her left edge. To her left of it, a horizontal transition zone crosses about 28% of the way down her figure from the top; to her right of it, a different horizontal transition zone crosses about 71% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is the upper area to her left of the vertical zone, above the left horizontal zone: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID PEARL scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the lower area to her left of the vertical zone, below the left horizontal zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the upper area to her right of the vertical zone, above the right horizontal zone: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING PALE GOLD scale formations, VIVID IVORY WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the lower area to her right of the vertical zone, below the right horizontal zone: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID DEEP EMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

#2: Korean, in her late 40s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone — an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, a cold, commanding gaze, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in elegant updo, real pores, real living eyes, 200 hoops piercings set with amethysts in silver-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of silver earrings. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is covered mainly by one background material, with 2 large round patches of other materials scattered irregularly across it, each patch roughly 27% of her figure's width across. Region 1 is the background: everything outside the round patches: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the round patch centred about 40% of the way down her figure from the top and about 46% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL eye-marking centres, VIVID GOLD radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 3 is the round patch centred about 44% of the way down her figure from the top and about 78% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID AMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The patch edges are hazy and feathered — there is no visible outline at all. Around each patch, a transition zone about a hand's width wide lets the patch's material and the background material dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each patch edge follows a smooth, round outline. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward, her extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#3: German, in her mid 40s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real pores, real living eyes, 100 hoops piercings set with pearls in silver-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of gold a ring. Fused with 2 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 thick diagonal stripes by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 28% of the way down her figure from the top, about 50% of the way down her figure from the top and about 74% of the way down her figure from the top. The stripes alternate between 2 materials in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the diagonal stripe between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID ORANGE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the diagonal stripe between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries the same material as Region 1. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries the same material as Region 2. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out, her extreme platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Environment: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient.
All: Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition, realistic photographic grain on the realistic-skin and pregnant women, extreme high-gloss oil on the darkest-skin women. CRITICAL: all 3 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere. THREE completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. 8K portrait 4:5 aspect ratio.
